categories.name: indexes
categories.evidence: Does not touch files under src/index/ or change index data structures, modifying only P2P message processing in src/net_processing.cpp.
categories.rationale: The change addresses how net_processing coordinates with the validation queue rather than changing index behavior or storage.

categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies BIP 157 message handling in src/net_processing.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents spurious peer disconnects and bans caused by dropping BIP 157 requests during the race window between block announcement and compact filter construction. As noted in issue #29655 and confirmed by ajtowns, compact filter calculation is slow enough that this race occurs occasionally even without high-bandwidth relay, breaking interoperability with light clients.
